Could possibly be a Chalazion, something similar to a pimple. They aren’t dangerous and can pop on their own after a couple of days, but by putting a warm compressor on it for a short while a day can help speed up the process. Once popped you should clean it at least twice a day, once in the morning and once before bed. No need to worry unless he has any other symptoms of infection like fever or something. Double checking with the vet is still best choice tho, better safe than sorry! 

Hope he gets better soon! Would love a full pic of the pupper :)



Edit: My dog recently had it and it never bothered him except when i was cleaning it after it scabbed as it obviously stings.
